answer: Picture a farmer who spins up 40 wallets from one exchange withdrawal and answers the same prompt from each. Under a per-funder cap of 3 seats per 24 epochs, 37 of them sit idle; renting 13 more funders at a 15 POA bond each costs 195 POA before one reward is paid. The registrar groups wallets by common first funder and by answer-submission gaps under 120 seconds, then freezes the cluster bond. Lone sonnet accounts near a quiet marble of lagoon hosts stay untouched.
